# PIKOM AI Chapter — Member Portal
> Malaysia's verified AI industry directory. 157 member organisations
> across 9 categories. Curated by PIKOM, Malaysia's National ICT Association.

## About
PIKOM AI Chapter represents 157 verified organisations spanning AI platforms,
system integrators, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, education, consultancy,
enterprise end-users, government agencies, and telecom operators.

## Key data
- 157 verified member organisations (September 2026)
- 9 ecosystem categories · Updated monthly

## Pages
/ — Portal home with ecosystem overview
/members — Full searchable directory by capability and category
/marketplace — Active AI requirement postings
/intelligence — Curated AI research from Anthropic, Stanford HAI, McKinsey
/community — Member forums and SIGs
/talent — AI job listings and HRD Corp-certified courses
/policy — Malaysian AI regulatory tracker
